name: print-social-white-maze-pattern-faq-slide-with-3d-blue-question-mark-and-chat-bubbles
title: FAQ Slide with 3D Question Mark and Chat Bubbles
whatItIs: A white slide covered in a faint maze-like line pattern with a ticket logo, a chunky glossy 3D blue question mark at the lower left, a tilted blue speech card with the question 'What if the seller sends me a fake ticket?', a blue answer card with escrow explanation and a hand-drawn swipe hint at the corner.
whatItMeans: Question and answer as chat bubbles make an FAQ feel like a conversation, and the 3D question mark is a clear symbol.
techniques: Question and answer as two speech cards
Glossy 3D question mark as a hero object
Faint maze pattern as a brand texture

vocabulary.definition: A card shaped like a chat bubble.
A repeated faint pattern unique to a brand.
A small illustrated cue to move to the next slide.
